content.expected_result: Current definitions are editable; factual evidence identities, exact pins, steps and supersession remain inspectable.
preconditions: A current case has a stable assertion step; save its definition bytes and digest before enrichment.

steps.action: Add evidence, change the assertion outcome in current content, then append a consciously reassessed record superseding the old evidence.
steps.expected_result: Enrichment leaves definition bytes unchanged; a definition edit makes the original pin stale. Replacement evidence restores current linkage without rewriting either factual evidence record or creating a second definition history store.

steps.action: Read public Quality and quality-runs output and compare factual evidence with the authored records.
steps.expected_result: Canonical identity, role, exact code, pinned test content digest, stable step IDs and supersession edges remain exact. Runs are exposed only as historical metadata.

content.title: Retain exact evidence pins across current definition edits
